title: Replying to @Auntie Abby Jan Maxwell performe a definitive “Could I L...
transcript: How could I leave you? What would I do on my own? Putting parts of you aside in the south of France? What I think of you aside. Darling, shall we dance? Would I live through the pain on a terrace in Spain? Would it pass? It would pass. Would I bury my graves with a boy half your age in the grass and your ass? But I've done that already. Tell me, how could I leave when I left long ago? No, the point is, could you leave me? Well, I guess you could leave me the house, leave me the front. Leave me the 20% of the money you make and the wrongs and the cost. You keep the drugs and don't you keep the books? But then I'll take the bread, sugar, you keep the spit. And all of our friends. Wait a goddamn minute. Oh, leave you? Leave you? How could I leave you? Sweetheart, I have to confess. Would I leave you? Yes. Yes. Who will I leave you?
